notes.title: Ashes Update 2.53 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The new Ashes update is finally live. Here is what you'll find included:

The Static epilogue has been added. It can be started if you choose to let Donald Weltman escape in Umbriol.
Fixed several spelling errors in the quest log
Modified spawn rates and level ranges, allowing players to actually over level certain areas.
Added party healing to the save points in the Norda Morlone labs, all save points now fully heal your party when activated.

As always, please let us know if there are any issues and we hope you enjoy the new content!

notes.title: Ashes Update - Continuation from Static!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The story for the Ashes update is well underway, we wanted to share a bit of what you guys can expect. The main character from Static will be encountered after finishing the sub story with the Weltman Hotel. We will tell you now that it will only open only IF you let Mr. Weltman escape. From there, you will be directed towards where the quest can be taken, and you will fight through an entirely new sub story to fully wrap up the story of Static! More to come soon...

notes.title: Ashes of Kanaka on IndieGala!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Sorry for the radio silence, we've been busy working on future projects and expanding the Ashes universe! We wanted to announce that Ashes of Kanaka is in an AMAZING indie bundle! Find it here at https://www.indiegala.com/indie-armored-steam-bundle!

For all of our new users from this bundle, Please let us know in the discussions if you have any comments of questions, we still actively work on improving Ashes and are trying to find what improvements we can make within the engine we were working with.

It would mean the world to us if you could write a review for Ashes of Kanaka, the more reviews we have the more likely we are to show up to new players and it is more likely for us to get into future bundles as well!

Since Ashes came out, we have been actively trying to find ways to expand upon what we have already created, however we have hit the max limit for what can go into an RPGMaker project. While it is great that we pushed the engine to its limits, it makes it very difficult for us to add new content. We have two options we are currently working on to combat this.

First of all, we have a spin off title, Static, that is coming out early next year (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cp0R1cYwpgE&t=3s) Static is a psychological thriller that is a prequel to the events of the main game. We hope to have more to share on this with an independent Steam page soon~

We also have long discussed remaking Ashes of Kanaka in a more powerful engine, such as Unreal 4. This would be a massive undertaking as those of you that have played can see how large the game was as a 2D JRPG. Translating that into 3D, meeting the quality standards we strive for, and including everything we wanted in the base game, will take a long time.

However, want to make a point that it is happening, we are working on it, and we want to hear from you, what would you like to see in a 3D remake of Ashes? 

We have a few ideas that would improve quality of life, and it would include a large amount of new content that we think will really improve the game.

Until we have more to show, we will still be here on the Ashes of Kanaka page, and will share more as soon as we have it!

Thank you so much for all of your support, we couldn't do any of this without you!

Love,

Dogwood Gaming

notes.title: Ashes of Kanaka Update Promotion
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Ashes of Kanaka is currently 30% off for the next week and a half, why did we do this? We appreciate each and everyone one of you that gave us feedback on our game, without you, we would have never been able to get it to the level it is today. While Dogwood Gaming is working on our next project, we did not forget Ashes, and wanted to make sure it was an RPGMaker game that would stand out among the rest. We hope this will encourage all the people who have Ashes on their wishlist to give us a shot, as well as bring in a new group of players to the very friendly community that has been built in the discussion boards.

notes.title: Major Ashes of Kanaka Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The update is now officially live, here's what we've changed:

You will joined by two companions at the start of the game, they are designed to help balance out the first part of the game

New story elements have been added based off the new companions

After much testing, we think this has balanced out the game, please let us know how it works for you and we hope this will make the start a lot more player friendly!

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.5: Class/Balancing/Zug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have spent the past few weeks working on bug fixes and balancing. We also have a pretty big change to announce. We have worked on tweaking Zug, he should now be fully functional without problems. We have done more balancing work with Los Postres and the dungeons in and around the area. Please let us know if this makes a substantial difference, we are determined to get this right.

The last big change is now when you go to choose a class, there is a description of what each class does, so you'll know what you're getting into before you decide at the start of the game.

Please let us know what you think and we hope you'll like the changes!

notes.title: Ashes of Kanaka on the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.notes: Hello everyone, we're very happy to announce that Ashes of Kanaka is down to 7.99 for the duration of the Steam Summer Sale. We hope to bring in the many people that have us on their wishlist, and for those who have picked us up during the sale, you'll find amazing help and guides from fellow players in the discussion posts. We encourage everyone to keep posting guides and help for what you find, there is a lot to find on Kanaka! We are still hard at work on more content for Ashes, and we are very excited to announce it to you all in the near future.

notes.title: Ashes of Kanaka 1.1 -- New Content Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am happy to announce that we are AHEAD of schedule, and have the full content update as promised. Below is the full list of new features and content, as well as what we are planning to bring to Ashes in the future. This will be live today as soon as it is done uploading.

Caveman Zug - The caveman you meet in Norda Morlone is now a companion, you can find him by the waterfall in Kushmala once you've done both quests related to his history. He explains a bit more as to how he arrived on Kanaka, and should hopefully fill in some blanks for those who have completed the game already. He has a dialogue across the entire game just like the other companions.

Recommended Levels - Most dungeons now inform you what the recommended level for each is, so you know what you're getting into.

OASE Crypts - The OASE Crypts have been slightly changed. There is far less combat, and key cards are not needed for many doors that required them before. We want this area to be more about discovery and exploration, we hope we have achieved that.

New Game + - For those of you have completed the true ending for Ashes, the quest completion to unlock it will carry over to your future play throughs, so you won't have to do the quest every time you want the true ending. We are doing this for our future plans which I will outline at the end.

Small bug fixes - Minor quality of life improvements and Victor will now properly carry over to your New Game + files.



While we have received feedback that people enjoyed the true ending, we want to give you more reason to continue to play Ashes of Kanaka. 

Over the summer, we plan to release more new content, free of charge, that will add new areas as well as new hub that will become available once you get the true ending. You will have the options to either take that save to new game +, or if you want to continue to the new content. I'm looking forward to sharing more when we get back from E3, and as always, please let us know if there are any problems.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.3! Revive and Map updates.
notes.notes:
We've added revive items to all shops after Los Postres. The revive items will no longer have error codes associated with them, either.

Medic Revive now works properly. Engine issues overcome!

Hospitals / OASE Bases now properly revive as well.

Map issues causing black screening fixed.

notes.title: Mac & Linux Versions and the Soundtrack
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you all for the successful launch on Steam today! We are currently working on getting the Mac and Linux versions of Ashes of Kanaka on Steam. They should be up within the week. 

The soundtrack is also going to be on the store soon, we are including all files that were a part of the game, so you will actually have several songs that didn't quite make it into the final product as well.

Thank you for all your support, and we hope you'll enjoy yourselves on Kanaka!
